details: My father has smoked Vantage for 25 yrs. and I for 10 yrs. He called Vantage 800 number about a week ago to ask about what we could do with the carton UPC. We had saved before you went to single pack type. Also why you didn’t send more coupons more often rather than some of the other expensive mailings but not as important to us as larger coupons and redemption plans. You sent him a $4.00 coupon but you sent me only a 2.00 coupon and that is also the thing that bothers us both enough to possibly cause us to change brands. I called a week to 10 days later stating same.
